limitations: Counterevidence: Natural residual lambda^N remains exponentially small. The example rejects prescribed faster scale for entire spectrum, not all localization. Cited 1992 primary theorem has same notation.

proposition.claim:
Lambda(A)+Delta_epsilon subset Lambda_epsilon(A_N,l) for epsilon=C rho^N, any r<1,rho>r, constant independent of N.

Bounded semi-infinite Toeplitz backward shift a1=1,ak=0 otherwise,l=1,f(z)=z;r=1/4,rho=1/2,lambda=3/4. All printed bandwidth and radius hypotheses hold.
